nodes.label: Anchor Binding Contract
nodes.statement: For a fixed admitted actual P,I,complete K,D,Phi,h, internal sorted tokens r,k support grounded K-relations Anchor(r),Bind(r,k),Use(r,k). theta_frame is their conjunction, with fixed/transported parameters. A separately grounded partial psi maps representation tokens to external E; organism anatomical membership M(O(P),psi(k)) is not internal Bind. No h(c) is asserted unless c is in its declared carrier.

nodes.proof: Definition plus independent actual-grounding assumptions; finite r/k/c/member witness demonstrates only abstract consistency.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Name/observer meaning does not install Bind/Use; finite protocol condition bits are not complete neural K; undefined psi/M requires domain restriction.

nodes.label: Coupled Role Witness
nodes.statement: For b,a in {0,1}, 0<t_O,t_A<1, lambda,mu>0, o=b-t_O+lambda*b*a and q=a-t_A+mu*a*b dissociate by sign at (1,0) and (0,1), yet o(1,1)-o(1,0)=lambda and q(1,1)-q(0,1)=mu are positive. Therefore this explicit schema has role dissociation and graded cross-modulation simultaneously.
nodes.domain: Declared finite abstract two-input family with strictly bounded thresholds and positive couplings; not measured neural states or fitted human output laws.
nodes.scope: Declared finite abstract two-input family with strictly bounded thresholds and positive couplings; not measured neural states or fitted human output laws.
nodes.proof: At (1,0), o=1-t_O>0,q=-t_A<0; at (0,1),o=-t_O<0,q=1-t_A>0. Subtraction at the fixed other-coordinate corners gives the two positive couplings. All hold together.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Classic algebra, not new mechanism; zero coupling retains sign pattern, outside stated positive-coupling claim. No subjective F assignment, group means fit, or universal neural independence conclusion.
